short: Record, list, edit and remove buy, sell, dividend and coupon operations

commands.example:
fui invest buy VWCE --account Broker --quantity 10 --price 100 --fees 1
  fui invest buy BTC --account Exchange --quantity 0.01 --price 95000 --cash-account Cash EUR

flags.name: price
flags.usage: unit price in the security currency

commands.example: fui invest coupon BTP2030 --account Broker --quantity 10 --price 1.5 --cash-account Cash

flags.name: price
flags.usage: unit price in the security currency

commands.example: fui invest dividend VWCE --account Broker --quantity 8 --price 0.5 --cash-account Cash

flags.name: price

commands.short: Edit the date, quantity, price or fees of an operation
commands.example:
fui invest edit 3 --quantity 12 --price 101.5
  fui invest edit 3 --date 2026-03-02 --dry-run

fui invest list --account Broker --kind buy
  fui invest list --security VWCE --json

flags.name: kind
flags.usage: operation kind filter: buy, sell, dividend or coupon

commands.short: Remove an operation together with its linked cash transaction
commands.example:
fui invest rm 3 --dry-run
  fui invest rm 3 --yes

flags.name: price
flags.usage: unit price in the security currency
